name: Oliceridine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP3A4/CYP2D6 oxidation predominates, with smaller CYP2C9/CYP2C19 contributions and subsequent glucuronidation. Inactive metabolites are eliminated mainly in urine and partly feces.
